headline: Former Hungarian Central Bank Governor Arrested on Financial Fraud Suspicions
summary: Hungary's former central bank governor György Matolcsy was arrested on suspicion of financial fraud linked to his time leading the national bank.
why: Legal actions involving central bank leadership can introduce institutional uncertainty and impact the credibility of regional financial governance.
